subject: Every dumped scope over every fixture example and canonical-manifest input: both coordinates must be valid source places and the end must not precede the start.
purpose: This is a fail-closed exact-row ledger for invalid source positions. A real source line may use column 0 as the native parser's end-of-previous-line boundary spelling, but line zero, a negative coordinate, a coordinate beyond the source, and a reversed scope are rejected. The ledger is intentionally empty: any future row is a regression. Scope coordinates remain the native parser's location metadata and are not interpreted as substring bounds. Fixture examples are regenerated by their registered CTest spec_runner command, preserving the suite's base options and each example's fence tags without consulting the stored expected dump. Canonical inputs use the manifest's ParseOptions through the same default public CLI invocation as the canonical candidate generator.
corpus: every example in packages/markdown-core/tests/fixtures/*.txt plus every case in specs/canonical-ast/manifest.json
